description_en: Obtains an SMS verification code for verifying the administrator phone number when applying for SMS qualifications
description_zh: 申请短信资质时，需要验证管理员手机号，请通过本接口获取短信验证码
name: RequiredPhoneCode

parameters.help_en:
The administrator phone number that receives the verification code.
The account that calls this operation to send the verification code must be the same account that submits the qualification. Otherwise, the call fails.
Phone number format: +/+86/0086/86 or a phone number without any prefix, for example, 1390000****
parameters.help_zh:
接收验证码的管理员手机号。
调用本接口发送验证码的账号和提交资质的账号必须是同一个，否则调用失败。
号码格式：+/+86/0086/86 或无任何前缀的手机号码，例如 1390000****
parameters.name: phone_no
